name: MMR Group, Inc.
old_description: MMR Group consistently ranks at the top of Engineering News-Record's annual specialty contractors list. We're no stranger to 1 million work-hour projects, and we manage 30 offices throughout North and South America.
about:
MMR Group, Inc. is headquartered in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and operates 30 offices across North and South America. The company employs approximately 725 people and consistently ranks at the top of Engineering News-Record's specialty contractors list.

The firm provides a multi-disciplined suite of services including electrical construction, instrumentation, power distribution, panel and modular control building fabrication, telecommunications and security systems, commissioning and start-up, power development, maintenance, and mission critical construction. MMR self-performs electrical, telecommunications, security, fire alarm, and gas services to reduce cycle times and cost per megawatt. Project experience includes a 1-million-work-hour effort on Shell Canada's Albian Oil Sands expansion with 725 craft workers on site, and the Chevron Big Foot platform where crews installed 1.7 million feet of cable, 119,000 feet of tubing, and 55,000 field terminations. A Modular Systems facility in Lafayette, Louisiana, supports off-site data-center skid assembly.

MMR serves chemical and petrochemical, oil and gas (upstream, midstream, downstream), industrial manufacturing, power generation, power development, renewable energy and energy storage, and telecommunications and security sectors. Clients include Black Hills Energy (Cheyenne Prairie natural-gas turbine project), Kinder Morgan (Elba Island 35kV/15kV), Shell Canada (Albian Oil Sands), Procter & Gamble (tissue machine plant), GE/Entergy (Perryville blackstart storage), and Chevron (Big Foot platform).

The company cites its diverse expertise, commitment to safety, quality, and client satisfaction, and the ability to complete projects on schedule and within budget as key differentiators. Since inception, MMR has demonstrated competency across broad sectors, combining state-of-the-art project controls, cutting-edge technology, and certified craftsmen to deliver critical infrastructure.
